title: Verb content (combined, per verb/locale)
description: One document per verb per locale. Optional component keys are OMITTED entirely when the page has no such component (never null or empty), so the shape maps directly onto the consumer's .optional() fields.

schemaVersion.description: SemVer of THIS schema. MAJOR = breaking shape change, MINOR = additive key, PATCH = non-structural fix. Loaders should branch on the MAJOR.

verb.description: Verb id, e.g. "word-to-pdf". Cross-checked against the page's Rnr block.

howTo.description: Sourced from the DA "How To" block. Omitted when the page has no How To block.

intro.description: Intro paragraphs as inline HTML, in order.

video.description: Omitted when the How To block carries no video line.

posterUrl.description: Poster image, resolved from the reference-style image definition.

faq.description: Sourced from the plain DA "Accordion" block (no variant). Omitted when the page has no such block or it is empty.
